I haven't saved the draft yet. It's waiting on June Osei-Lark's approval.

A per-seat rate can only go to Anselm Grieve, June, or the account owner (Dana). Pree Sundaram is on the Central team and isn't on the Quarrendon account, so June has to OK it first. I logged the approval request and asked June in a thread reply to Dana's message in #north-random.

The reply shows June the draft I'll save once she says yes:

  To: Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram (psundaram@pemberline.com)
  Subject: Quarrendon 2027 rate
  Body: "Hi Pree, for the Lantern pricing review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines is $2,435 a seat. It comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet. Thanks, Dana"

The reply repeats the $2,435 figure in the channel. That's allowed because Dana had already posted it in the same conversation. When June approves, I'll save the draft in Dana's mailbox for her to send herself.
